title: Spider-Man: Miles Morales
summary: Shorter follow-up where Miles protects Harlem with new venom powers.

moments.label: Prison Convoy Escort
moments.detail: Help Peter Parker protect the prison convoy transporting escapees.

moments.label: Rhino's Escape
moments.detail: Fight Rhino after he breaks out of the transport payload.

moments.label: Chaos in the Mall
moments.detail: Battle escaping criminals through the mall with Peter Parker.

moments.label: Peter is Injured
moments.detail: Peter gets pinned under debris by Rhino during the fierce battle.

moments.label: Unlocking Bioelectricity
moments.detail: Miles discovers a new bioelectric power while facing Rhino.

moments.label: Stopping Rhino
moments.detail: Defeat Rhino and prevent further destruction in the city.

moments.label: Holodeck Training
moments.detail: Learn new moves and techniques in the holographic training challenges.

moments.label: Tech Thieves Ambush
moments.detail: Defeat the invisible tech thieves trying to steal Spider-Man gear.

moments.label: Roxxon Plaza Incident
moments.detail: Investigate a break-in at Roxxon Plaza and discover the new reactor.

moments.label: Roxxon Security Fight
moments.detail: Fight Roxxon security guards while investigating the plaza break-in.

moments.label: Christmas Dinner Arrives
moments.detail: Enjoy Christmas dinner at home with family and friends like Ganke and Finn.

moments.label: Restoring Power
moments.detail: Use bioelectricity to jumpstart the circuit breaker and fix the blackout.

moments.label: Mom's Campaign Speech
moments.detail: Listen to Rio's campaign plans and discuss Simon Krieger and Roxxon.

moments.label: Ganke's App Upgrade
moments.detail: Ganke works on a custom operating system app for Miles's new suit.

videos.summary: Miles Morales trains as Spider-Man and defends New York from a massive prison break.
